title: PetTripFinder machine-review decisions
description: Durable, append-only record of human decisions on machine-verified capture reviews. A reversal or correction is a NEW entry; an existing entry is never edited or removed. Carries no screenshot, no HTML, no policy excerpt, no absolute path and no credential -- the evidence lives outside git and is referenced only by hash.

field_decisions.description: Per-field verdict. A REJECTED field is withheld from promotion while the record as a whole may still be approved.

overlap_approved.description: Required true before a COMPARE_ONLY published overlap may be promoted. Prevents any automatic overwrite of an existing published fact.

source_record_hash.description: Hash of the machine-review record this decision was made against. Promotion re-derives it from the record's own content; a mismatch means the evidence changed and the decision no longer applies.
